newsitem.title: UK: Euromoney buys MPI stake in travel magazine.
newsitem.headline: Euromoney buys MPI stake in travel magazine.

text.p: British financial publisher Euromoney Publications Plc said on Monday it had bought an initial 74.9 percent stake in Perry Publications Ltd from German publisher Motor-Presse International (MPI) -- giving it an interest in the German, U.S. and British editions of Business Traveller magazine.
"Consideration for the acquisition was 1.95 million stg, comprising 0.41 million stg cash and 1.54 million stg repayment of inter-company loans," Euromoney said in a statement.
Euromoney is buying Perry through a new company called Business Traveller (Holdings) and initially the remaining 25.1 percent interest in that company will be held by N.Perry.
The group added it had made put and call arrangements whereby Perry would be able to sell his shares to Euromoney "at a pre-determined multiple of post-tax profits".
"The aggregate consideration payable to Mr Perry has been capped at 5 million stg," Euromoney added.

"The Euromoney board believes that the purchase of the Business Traveller magazine operations fits well with Euromoney's strategy of building strongly branded cross-border magazine titles," the statement concluded.
